scope: BLS dated Employment Situation release statements on revisions to the prior two monthly payroll changes
limits: January 2022 is a benchmark release without a standard two-month revision paragraph in the retrieved page; its two-month fields are blank, not zero.
Other January releases can include annual benchmark and seasonal-factor changes; prior revisions are recorded as printed, not assumed to be ordinary monthly-only revisions.
Original posting bytes/time and market receipt are unauthenticated.
